name_reason: Name follows fd2_<descriptor> game-function convention, accurately reflects logic (re-derives a runtime/menu char slot's total combat stats), and carries no Ghidra address residue. Domain-style siblings in battle.c use the same fd2_<verb>_<descriptor> form (fd2_recalculate_combat_stats, fd2_read_tile_attribute_at_pos).
purpose: Re-derive a menu/roster character slot's equip-adjusted combat aggregate stats (AP/DP/DX/evade) by summing the slot's per-level base values plus boosts from all equipped inventory items.
logic_summary: slot_addr = roster_buffer_ptr + slot_idx*0x50. Seeds ap_total/dp_total/dx_total from slot fields +0x37/+0x39/+0x3E (base per-level stats); stat4_total (evade/defender-DX) starts equal to dx_total. Loops the 8 inventory slots (slot_iter 0..7); for each whose flag byte (inv_slot+0xA) has bit 0x40 (equipped marker) set, fetches the item-effect entry via fd2_get_item_effect_entry(inv_slot+0xB) and adds the item's s16 boosts: +1->AP, +3->DX(HT), +5->DP, +7->evade(EV). Finally writes the four 16-bit totals back to slot +0x48 (AP), +0x4A (DP), +0x4C (DX), +0x4E (evade). __CHK(0x24) frame check at entry. No early returns; cyclomatic complexity 3.

params.name: slot_idx
params.semantics: Index into the menu/template party roster array (data_fd2_shared_menu_party_roster_buffer_ptr); slot stride is 0x50 bytes. Callers pass menu_party_member_count (after slot init) or the matched template index tmpl_idx (after writing runtime char back). In Ghidra this param is still the generic placeholder param_1; src already names it slot_idx.
params.reason: Ghidra name param_1 is a generic placeholder that does not reflect usage (it is a roster slot index). Source already uses the accurate name slot_idx; align Ghidra to it in Stage 2. Not applied here (param rename deferred to Stage 2).

returns.semantics: No return value. Side effect: writes the four 16-bit aggregate combat stats (AP/DP/DX/evade) into the roster slot at offsets +0x48/+0x4A/+0x4C/+0x4E.

comment_original_issue: Original src comment was correct but minimal ('Sums base + equipped-item boosts. Operates on menu roster buffer.'): it omitted the seeded base fields, the 0x40 equipped marker, the four output offsets (+0x48..+0x4E), the item-effect field mapping, and the relationship to the battle-array twin fd2_recalculate_combat_stats.
